Use Borrowing Capacity in your AI

Install one skill in Claude, ChatGPT or Grok, then ask your question in plain words. Your AI looks up what you did not say, lists every assumption with its source, and replies with one link that opens Borrowing Capacity on your scenario. The tool works out the answer, so the figures you see are the tool's, not the chatbot's.

⬇ Download brotools-borrowingcapacity.zip Open the tool

A .zip skill: SKILL.md (how to answer), references/ (every input, its range and the Quick Starts) and scripts/build_link.py (builds and checks the link). Read SKILL.md

Install the skill

Pick your assistant. The demo plays the steps; press a step to jump to it.

    Menus move as these apps update; look for Skills in Settings. Skills need the app's code tool switched on (Claude: Code execution and file creation). No skill support on your plan? Attach brotools-borrowingcapacity.zip or SKILL.md to the chat and say "use this skill".

    How to use it

    Ask as you would ask a friend. With the skill on, the AI keeps your figures, researches the rest, and hands you the link. It does not give the answer itself: the tool does, once you open the link.

    using tool.adjiebrotots.com/borrowingcapacity, how much can a couple earning $120,000 and $85,000 in Sydney borrow?

    Using skill brotools-borrowingcapacity Ran scripts/build_link.py: link checked

    Your inputs

    • City: Sydney

    Assumptions

    1. Household: two applicants and no dependants. The link starts from the Couple Quick Start (qs=couple), which keeps private hospital cover on, no study loan, a card limit of 15,000, a loan at 5.9% a year over 30 years and the 2026-27 tax year.
    2. Income: $205,000 a year gross between the two, with the second applicant's share set to 40%, the nearest step to $85,000 of $205,000.
    3. Living costs: $4,000 a month declared; the lender uses the higher of this and its own benchmark.
    4. Home and deposit: a $1,100,000 home with $250,000 saved, stamp duty at 4% of the price and $4,000 of other purchase costs, none of which the user gave.
    InputValueSource or rationale
    Quick StartcoupleNearest local starting point
    CitySydneyYou said
    Total employment income$205,000 /yr$120,000 plus $85,000 gross a year, before tax
    Second applicant’s share of income40 %The second applicant earns $85,000, about 41% of $205,000, and the slider moves in steps of 5
    DependantsNo dependantsNo children were mentioned, and the Couple Quick Start has two
    Declared living expenses$4,000 /moA typical monthly figure for two adults with no children, excluding rent and debts
    Purchase price$1,100,000A typical Sydney price for a home a couple on this income might shop for
    Deposit funds$250,000Savings for the purchase were not given, so a typical amount for a couple at this income
    Stamp duty4 % of priceNew South Wales stamp duty on about $1.1M is about 4% of the price

    Open the link to see the result.

    Open this scenario
    • Your figures stay yours. Anything you state goes in as you said it; correct any assumption and the AI sends a new link.
    • Checked before you see it. The skill's script knows every input, its range and its choices, so the link opens exactly the scenario listed.
    • The tool shows what the AI chose. When the link opens, a banner lists each value the AI set and why, with an Undo back to your own inputs.
